name: SPDR Gold Shares (Ondo Tokenized)
oneLiner: GLDon is Ondo’s NAV-style SPDR Gold Shares tracker, redeemable by eligible investors through issuer stablecoin rails without ETF delivery rights.
collateral: SPDR Gold Shares (GLD) ETF exposure and cash in transit secure a debt claim on Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited. Final Terms also permit Other and Additional Collateral; current GLDon-specific weights are undisclosed.
pegMechanism: Total-return tracker of SPDR Gold Shares with issuer-calculated NAV and eligible-investor subscription/redemption. Ordinary redemption is to USDon; conversion to USDC depends on whitelist access and stablecoin-swapper liquidity. No fixed $1 peg or physical-gold redemption.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The March 26, 2026 GLDon Final Terms bind the Ethereum token 0x423d42e505e64f99b6e277eb7ed324cc5606f139 to a debt instrument tracking SPDR Gold Shares. Ondo identifies native Ethereum, BNB and Solana issuance and bridged HyperEVM. This fund-security tracker belongs to the same rwa-credit-fund investment surface as IAUon and SLVon, not direct allocated gold.

proofOfReserves.provider: Ankura Trust Company, LLC. The October 16, 2026 daily report (8pm ET) and September 1-30, 2026 monthly report, retrieved from the issuer-linked archives on 2026-10-20, reconcile pooled Ondo Stocks, USDY and USDon assets and liabilities. Neither publishes GLDon-specific GLD shares, cash, Other Collateral, liabilities or provider weights; no exact-token financial assurance is asserted.

notices.title: Tokenized ETF exposure
notices.message: GLDon provides economic exposure to SPDR Gold Shares. Holders have no right to receive ETF shares or physical gold; investor eligibility and issuer redemption restrictions apply.
